name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the response relates to the context and previous messages in the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the response to maintain or enhance interest in the conversation, including the use of follow-up questions or additional information.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and clarity of the response within the context of the conversation.

name: Informational Value
description: Measures the presence of new, interesting, or valuable information provided in the response, including facts or personal anecdotes.

name: Empathy
description: Assesses the degree to which the response demonstrates understanding, compassion, or emotional connection to the other participant's statements.

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly in how it adds to the conversation creatively.
